problem: The judgment failed to consider exclusion criterion E4, which excludes patents that mention 3D printing but focus on integrating electronic devices without involving the creation of 3D printed objects as part of the integration process. The patent abstract indicates that the focus is on 3D printing for electrical wiring, which suggests integration of electronic devices. There is no evidence in the provided text that the patent involves the creation of 3D printed objects as part of the integration process, which would make it out of domain according to E4.
